header.name: Receiving
header.description:
This screen allows for basic receiving functionality, presenting the user a list of open orders which can then be confirmed and received.

More advanced functionality can be found in the Advanced Receiving screen.

props.description:
Data change set for 90 days by default, changes to the orders should only be initiated from the external ERP system or via other mechnisms and typically not done manually via Fuuz - however, if you do make manual changes, those changes will be tracked for 90 days unless this setting is modified.

Deleting an Order, will delete the line and release - providing no other transactions have been performed.
